name: Helmed Horror
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
languages: understands the languages of its creator

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The helmed horror has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spell Immunity
entries: The helmed horror is immune to three spells chosen by its creator (aqui: fireball, lightning bolt, magic missile).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The helmed horror makes two longsword attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) slashing damage, or 10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) if used with two hands.

fluffEntries: **Armaduras da Casa:** sentinelas de Osybus. Atuam em formação, flanqueando e usando voo para cercar conjuradores.
